title: 第二十三章祸及家人你是认真的第二十四章触我逆鳞者必死
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
天黑前，顾晦走出青峰武馆侧门。
签下生死契，顾晦也就成为了青峰武馆的试功弟子，也算是武馆的供奉武师于北海的亲传弟子。
没有花一分钱，他离开的时候还带走了一些东西，一套有着青峰武馆标志的棉服，刻着他姓名的木牌。
身为试功弟子，武馆提供免费食宿。
花钱进来练武的正式弟子，食宿什么的都要钱，和试功弟子相比，反倒像是后娘养的。
顾晦听顾长青说过，哪怕不算买丹药花的钱，顾谭在青峰武馆每个月的花销都要好几两银子，吃饭要花钱，衣服要花钱，武器要花钱，使用练功器械也有折旧费……
无处不要钱！
试功弟子倒是不要钱，然而，却要命，所以，免费的往往才是最贵的，这句话诚不我欺！
顾晦没有选择留宿武馆。
他是本地人，可以回家。
像他这样土生土长的白沙镇子民，签下了生死契之后就是青峰武馆的人，反悔的代价极其严重，所以，武馆的人允许他回家居住，只要按时前来修炼即可。
今日报名，明日才能修炼。
修炼的地点不在青峰武馆的本馆这里，而是在镇子东边的一栋独立院落内，修炼的时间也不是白天，而是入夜之后，明天晚上顾晦准时出现在那里就行。
那里距离顾晦家不远。
顾晦若要进山，途经一个三岔口时，那栋院子就在另一条路尽头的竹林内。
对他而言，倒也方便。
出门后，顾晦把青峰武馆的棉服披在了身上，青色的棉衣，黑色的腰带，左胸处绣着一座同样黑色的山峰，但凡穿着这样的衣服，也就是青峰武馆的弟子。
这身皮是顾晦来此的目的之一，让王麻子这样的牛鬼蛇神忌惮，自然要穿在身上。
顾晦走出巷子，回头看了看青峰武馆。
今天，他没有在武馆里面遇见顾谭，倒是在庶务堂签协议的时候从那些人的闲谈中听到了顾谭的名字。

三个月时间，锤炼出三百多缕气血，快要一次淬体圆满，在青峰武馆的近期弟子里面，算是一个难得的天才，日后，说不定有机会获得武馆举荐信去参加武道考核。
武道考核啊！
顾晦也颇为向往！
……
一路走来，顾晦遇到了一些熟人。
瞧见他穿着青峰武馆的衣服，大多瞠目结舌，颇为震惊，对他的态度顿时有了改变。
以前，顾晦是一个不学无术的街溜子。
熟人们就算和他见面打招呼，眼神也带着嫌弃和厌恶，他在他们心目中就像是路边的一坨……
披上青峰武馆的这层皮之后，神情顿时不同。
透着几分小心，几分讨好，这些熟人几乎都先一步向顾晦问好，然后，小声地询问他是不是拜入了武馆。
顾晦微笑着应是。
顾长青变成了废人，顾家老爷子放弃了医治他的打算，在这些邻人眼里，顾家肯定完蛋了，顾晦这个浪荡子撑不起这个家，但是，顾晦进入了武馆修行……
那就不好说了！
但是，顾家没钱给顾长青疗伤，有钱让顾晦进入武馆？
啥情况？
背地里难免小声嘀咕。
content_en:
Before dark, Gu Hui walked out of the side door of Qingfeng Martial Arts Hall.
After signing the life-and-death contract, Gu Hui became a disciple of the Qingfeng Martial Arts School, and also a direct disciple of the martial arts master Yu Beihai.
He didn't spend a penny, and he took some things with him when he left, a set of cotton clothes with the logo of Qingfeng Martial Arts School, and a wooden sign with his name engraved on it.
As a martial arts disciple, the martial arts hall provides free food and accommodation.
Formal disciples who spend money to practice martial arts have to pay for food, accommodation, etc. Compared with disciples who are trying their best, they are like stepmothers.
Gu Hui heard Gu Changqing say that even if the money spent on buying elixirs was not included, Gu Tan's monthly expenses at Qingfeng Martial Arts Hall were several taels of silver. Food cost money, clothes cost money, weapons cost money, and the use of training equipment also had depreciation fees...
No money required anywhere!
The disciples who try out their skills don’t need money, but they cost their lives. Therefore, the free ones are often the most expensive ones. I’m honest with you!
Gu Hui did not choose to stay at the martial arts school.
He is local and can come home.
As a native of Baisha Town, he signed a life-and-death contract and became a member of the Qingfeng Martial Arts School. The price of going back on his word was extremely serious, so the people of the Martial Arts School allowed him to go home and live as long as he came to practice on time.
Sign up today and practice tomorrow.
The place of practice is not at the main hall of Qingfeng Martial Arts School, but in an independent courtyard on the east side of the town. The time for practice is not during the day, but after nightfall. Gu Hui just needs to show up there on time tomorrow night.
It was not far from Gu Hui's home.
When Gu Hui wanted to enter the mountain, when he passed a three-way intersection, the courtyard was in the bamboo forest at the end of the other road.
For him, it's convenient.
After going out, Gu Hui put on the cotton-padded clothes from Qingfeng Martial Arts School. The green cotton-padded clothes, black belt, and a similarly black mountain peak were embroidered on the left chest. Anyone who wore such clothes was a disciple of Qingfeng Martial Arts School.
This skin was one of Gu Hui's purposes for coming here. It frightened a ghost like Wang Mazi, so he naturally wanted to wear it.
Gu Hui walked out of the alley and looked back at Qingfeng Martial Arts School.
Today, he did not meet Gu Tan in the martial arts hall, but he heard Gu Tan's name from the chat between those people when signing the agreement in the General Affairs Hall.
In three months, he has tempered more than 300 strands of energy and blood, and is about to complete the body tempering. Among the recent disciples of Qingfeng Martial Arts School, he is considered a rare genius. In the future, he may have the opportunity to obtain a recommendation letter from the martial arts school to participate in the martial arts assessment.
Martial arts assessment!
Gu Hui is also quite yearning for it!
…
Along the way, Gu Hui met some acquaintances.
When they saw him wearing the clothes from Qingfeng Martial Arts School, most of them were dumbfounded and shocked, and their attitude towards him suddenly changed.
In the past, Gu Hui was an ignorant street kid.
Even when acquaintances meet and greet him, their eyes are full of disgust and disgust. In their minds, he is like a piece of shit on the roadside...
After putting on this layer of skin from Qingfeng Martial Arts School, his expression suddenly changed.
With a certain amount of caution and a certain amount of flattery, most of these acquaintances greeted Gu Hui first, and then asked him in a low voice whether he had joined a martial arts school.
Gu Hui responded with a smile.
Gu Changqing became a useless person, and the old man of the Gu family gave up his plan to cure him. In the eyes of these neighbors, the Gu family was definitely doomed. Gu Hui, a prodigal, could not support the family. However, Gu Hui entered the martial arts hall to practice...
That’s hard to say!
However, the Gu family has no money to treat Gu Changqing's injuries, but has the money to let Gu Hui enter a martial arts gym?
What's going on?
It was inevitable to whisper behind his back.
